chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who does not find water: does he perform tayammum for every salat (prayer)? He said: “No, it is in the position of water.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.أَيَتَيَمَّمُ: does he perform tayammum, the dry ablution
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: water, meaning the normal means of purification
key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: in the position or status of

ai.seo_question: Does a person who cannot find water have to perform tayammum for every salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tayammum when water is unavailable. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that tayammum takes the place of water, indicating that it is not necessary to repeat tayammum for every salat (prayer) in this circumstance.
